gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Machined and punchy, Oxanium makes its lowercase look big, with strokes of ruler-straight weight. And Noto Sans Tangsa, with its wide, inviting round letters, rewards a slightly generous body size.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-numans: Commanding Oxanium keeps every stroke at ruler-straight weight, while Numans spreads its modern lowercase wide with generously loose tracking. The standout quality here is that wire-smooth heading line.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-orienta: Orienta breathes through open counters and barely distinguishes its cases by height. Oxanium does the loud work, with stress-free curves and a big-looking lowercase, while Orienta quietly handles the reading.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-prompt: Wiry and loud up top, oversized and friendly below. Oxanium excels at commanding attention with its single-weight strokes, while Prompt does the quiet work of staying readable through its open apertures.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-puritan: Straight-edged drama up top, round softness below. Oxanium does best with bold display strokes of unvarying weight, while Puritan does best with rounded forms and generously oversized, open counters.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-yaldevi: Expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister sits low with barely raised ascenders and untapered strokes. But Yaldevi keeps paragraphs moving, its outsized lowercase and open e eye staying clear.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-saira: Lowercase that climbs nearly to capital height gives Gugi its bold stance, with joins drawn at full stroke width. And Saira follows with see-through s shapes and rounded letters, so the text moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-savate: Expressive Offside lets its curves refuse to close, with wide tracking. Savate then settles in with open-jawed curves, sturdy hairlines and a tall rounded o, so longer text reads smoothly.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Oxanium draws everything like one smooth, unbroken wire. Schibsted Grotesk sits beside it with big, open-looking bowls and terminals that never close in, so the two feel friendly and firm.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sofia-sans: Spaghetti-like strokes of identical width give Funnel Display its commanding look, with c tips that never creep toward touching. Sofia Sans backs it up with tall, stencil-crisp lowercase and no stroke modulation.
